result.title: VidEngram: Agentic Long-Term Video Understanding via Structured Hierarchical Memory
result.comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Demo video and code are linked in the paper
result.summary: Long-video question answering is wasteful and lossy when a multimodal model must re-encode the same video for every query: context limits force sparse sampling or truncation, and no reusable representation remains for later questions. We present VidEngram, an agentic video QA system that builds a persistent hierarchical memory once at ingest and answers later questions from that memory. VidEngram captions video and audio jointly with Qwen2.5-Omni, consolidates segment memories into episode and entity layers, and uses a text-only agentic planner with specialized retrieval tools to produce grounded answers. The web interface makes this process inspectable: users can watch memory formation, inspect retrieval traces, verify cited evidence in the video player, and explore entity relationships. On the full OmniVideoBench, VidEngram with a GPT-5-mini planner outperforms a strong single-pass Qwen2.5-Omni baseline (37.0% vs. 32.3%), with gains concentrated on longer videos where single-pass coverage becomes sparse. Because perception is paid once, subsequent queries use low-cost text-only planning.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 VidEngram，一个长视频问答系统：在摄取阶段用 Qwen2.5-Omni 联合音视频字幕化并构建分层持久记忆（片段—事件—实体层），后续提问由纯文本 agentic planner 调用检索工具作答，并可通过网页界面查看记忆形成与证据轨迹。
AI.relevance_reason: 它把视觉证据一次性压缩为外部文本记忆、之后全靠文本规划检索，可作为「视觉旁路」「信息坍缩」与长视频证据筛选的对照方案，其长视频增益也提示上下文覆盖不足的问题；但状态是显式文本记忆而非 latent 推理状态，细节保留与检索充分性可供核查。
